section.content: 本发明公开了一种生物工程用生物基因检测仪，包括检测台，检测台内开设有输送腔，输送腔内设置有输送组件，输送组件用于将试管进行传送，检测台的顶端固设有L型板，L型板的顶端设置有检测组件，检测组件对试管内的样品进行检测，L型板的底端转动安装有转动柱，转动柱的外周上设置有封闭组件，封闭组件用于解除试管密封状态，本发明在试管内的样品进行检测前解除密封状态，且解除后第一时间进行检测，保证样品处于无菌的环境，使检测结果更加精准，同时采用间歇式固定的方法，试管方便取放，同时还可以使试管竖直，进行快速检测。

The invention discloses a biological gene detector for bioengineering, which comprises a detection table, wherein a conveying cavity is formed in the detection table, a conveying assembly is arranged in the conveying cavity and used for conveying a test tube, an L-shaped plate is fixedly arranged at the top end of the detection table, a detection assembly is arranged at the top end of the L-shaped plate and used for detecting a sample in the test tube, a rotating column is rotatably arranged at the bottom end of the L-shaped plate, a sealing assembly is arranged on the periphery of the rotating column and used for relieving the sealing state of the test tube, the sealing state of the sample in the test tube is relieved before the detection, the detection is carried out at the first time after the relief, the sample is ensured to be in a sterile environment, the detection result is more accurate, and meanwhile, an intermittent fixing method is adopted, the test tube is convenient to take and place, and can be vertical, and the rapid detection can be carried out.

Biological gene detector for bioengineeringTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of biological detection, in particular to a biological gene detector for biological engineering.

Background

The gene detection is a technology for detecting DNA through blood, other body fluids or cells, and is a method for detecting DNA molecular information in cells of a detected person through specific equipment after the peripheral venous blood or other tissue cells of the detected person are taken and the gene information is amplified, and analyzing whether the gene type, the gene defect and the expression function of the gene contained in the cells of the detected person are normal or not, so that people can know the gene information of themselves, and the etiology is determined or the risk of the body to suffer from a certain disease is predicted;

for example, a Chinese utility model patent with the publication number of CN214088505U discloses a biotech gene detection device, which relates to the technical field of biological detection and comprises a box body, wherein the top end of the inner part of the box body is fixedly connected with a first motor, the output shaft of the first motor is coaxially and fixedly connected with a rotating rod, the outer side of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a rotating feed roller, the side end of the rotating feed roller is provided with a plurality of test tube mounting grooves, the top end of the inner part of the box body, which is positioned at the top end of the rotating feed roller, is provided with a detection mechanism, and the inner part of the box body, which is positioned at the rotating feed roller, is provided with a test tube transfer device;

but the sample in the test tube needs to keep a sealed state, carries out continuous detection through the rotation mode, can't make the sample be in aseptic environment always like this, leads to the testing result inaccurate, and the test tube is placed on the test tube fixed plate, does not have the restriction to the test tube degree of freedom, and the test tube inclines easily at the rotation in-process, leads to the sample unrestrained with unable smooth detection.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to provide a biological gene detector for bioengineering, which is used for overcoming the defects in the prior art.

The bio-gene detector for bioengineering comprises a detection table, wherein a conveying cavity is formed in the detection table, a conveying assembly is arranged in the conveying cavity, and the conveying assembly is used for conveying a test tube;

an L-shaped plate is fixedly arranged at the top end of the detection platform, a detection assembly is arranged at the top end of the L-shaped plate, and the detection assembly is used for detecting a sample in a test tube;

a rotating column is rotatably mounted at the bottom end of the L-shaped plate, a sealing assembly is arranged on the periphery of the rotating column, and the sealing assembly is used for relieving the sealing state of the test tube;

the conveying assembly comprises a conveying box, and a connecting plate is fixedly arranged at one end of the conveying box; the detection assembly comprises a detector, and a hose is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the detector; the sealing assembly comprises a lifting box, and a pulling-out plate is arranged in the lifting box in a sliding mode.

Further, the diapire in transport chamber has set firmly the conveying motor, conveying motor top power is connected with the conveying axle, conveying axle top has set firmly the rotor plate, conveying case bilateral symmetry sets up carry intracavity portion, and two the connecting plate all with rotor plate fixed connection, it has set firmly the backup pad to carry the chamber diapire, the connecting plate with backup pad sliding connection, the conveying case transports the test tube, the backup pad supports the connecting plate rotates.

Further, the transfer box top has been seted up and has been placed the chamber, the inside wall of placing the chamber has set firmly the support ring, the diapire of placing the chamber has set firmly the sponge piece, it is equipped with the grip block to place intracavity lateral sliding, just the grip block distributes along circumference and sets up, every the grip block all runs through the transfer box extends away, the sponge piece supports and puts into place the test tube of intracavity, the grip block makes the test tube keep vertical state.

Further, every the bottom of grip block all has set firmly the diversion board, the power chamber has been seted up to conveying incasement portion, every the diversion board all runs through conveying case and extending to power intracavity portion, the diversion board extends to the upper and lower end of power intracavity portion all has set firmly the mounting panel, is located the top the mounting panel with all install the extension spring between the power intracavity wall, be located the below the one end of mounting panel all articulates there is the propelling movement ball, the propelling movement ball is used for the transmission, thereby promotes the diversion board carries out lateral shifting.

Further, the power intracavity slides from top to bottom and is equipped with the lifter plate, the bottom of lifter plate has set firmly the connecting rod, the connecting rod runs through conveying case and downwardly extending goes out, the bottom that the connecting rod extended out the part articulates there is the ball, the top of lifter plate has set firmly the inserted block, the inserted block distributes along circumference and sets up, the inserted block with it corresponds to promote the ball, the lifter plate provides power, makes diversion board lateral shifting.

Further, the dashpot has all been seted up to the one end that the grip block is close to each other, it is equipped with the buffer block all to slide in the dashpot, the buffer block with all install buffer spring between the dashpot inner wall, carry the chamber bottom wall to set firmly the arc, the slip of buffer block can adapt to the test tube of different diameters and carry out the centre gripping, the arc makes the lifter plate can slide from top to bottom.

Furthermore, the detector is fixedly arranged at the top end of the L-shaped plate, a hydraulic cylinder is fixedly arranged at the top end of the L-shaped plate, a hydraulic rod is dynamically connected to the bottom end of the hydraulic cylinder, a liquid pump is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the hydraulic rod and communicated with the hose, a suction pipe is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the liquid pump, the detector detects the sample, and the liquid pump extracts the sample into the detector.

Further, the bottom of the rotating column is fixedly connected with the top end of the rotating plate, fixed plates are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on the periphery of the rotating column, electromagnets are fixedly arranged at the bottom ends of the fixed plates, rectangular grooves are symmetrically and transversely arranged on the periphery of the rotating column, limiting rods are fixedly arranged between the upper inner wall and the lower inner wall of each rectangular groove, a lifting box is arranged on the periphery of each limiting rod in a vertical sliding mode, the lifting box is slidably connected with the inner wall of each rectangular groove, transverse grooves are formed in the lifting box, the extracting plate is slidably arranged in the transverse grooves, electric telescopic rods are fixedly arranged on the inner walls of the transverse grooves, the electric telescopic rods are fixedly connected with the extracting plate, magnetic blocks are fixedly arranged at the top ends of the lifting box, the extracting plate clamps the sealing covers, and the electromagnets attract the lifting box to move vertically.

The invention has the beneficial effects that: the invention releases the sealing state before the sample in the test tube is detected, and the detection is carried out at the first time after the release, so that the sample is ensured to be in a sterile environment, and the detection result is more accurate.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only a part of the embodiments of the present invention, and not all of the embodiments.

In the description of the present invention, it is to be understood that the terms "upper", "lower", "front", "rear", "left", "right", "vertical", "horizontal", "top", "bottom", "inner", "outer", etc. indicate orientations or positional relationships based on those shown in fig. 1, and are only for convenience of describing the present invention and simplifying the description, but do not indicate or imply that the referred device or element must have a specific orientation, be constructed and operated in a specific orientation, and thus, should not be construed as limiting the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1 to 8, a biological gene testing instrument for biological engineering according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a testing platform 11, a conveying cavity 12 is formed in the testing platform 11, a conveying assembly 53 is disposed in the conveying cavity 12, and the conveying assembly 53 is used for conveying a test tube;

an L-shaped plate 20 is fixedly arranged at the top end of the detection table 11, a detection assembly 52 is arranged at the top end of the L-shaped plate 20, and the detection assembly 52 detects a sample in a test tube;

the bottom end of the L-shaped plate 20 is rotatably provided with a rotating column 19, the periphery of the rotating column 19 is provided with a sealing component 54, and the sealing component 54 is used for releasing the sealing state of the test tube;

wherein, the conveying component 53 comprises a conveying box 18, and one end of the conveying box 18 is fixedly provided with a connecting plate 17; the detection assembly 52 comprises a detector 23, and a hose 24 is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the detector 23; the closure assembly 54 includes a lift box 45 with a take-up plate 48 slidably disposed within the lift box 45.

Referring to fig. 2, the support plate 13 has a circular ring shape, and the connection plate 17 is always in contact with the support plate 13 during rotation.

Referring to fig. 6, the arc plate 41 is a segment of arc, and both ends of the arc plate 41 are inclined planes, and the directions of the two inclined planes are opposite.

Referring to fig. 7, the elevating plate 37 has a rectangular shape, and one surface of the insertion block 42 is an inclined surface.

Referring to fig. 4, the sliding ball 36 slides on the surface of the arc plate 41 to enable the lifting plate 37 to perform a lifting cycle, the tension spring 38 is initially in a stretched state, the support ring 56 is fixed on the inner wall of the placing cavity 55, and the support ring 56 is used for supporting the test tube before the test tube is not fixed.

The invention relates to a biological gene detector for bioengineering, which comprises the following working procedures: the test tube is placed into the conveying box 18 on the left side, the test tube is not fixed at the moment, deflection can occur and is abutted to the supporting ring 56, the bottom end of the test tube is placed at the top end of the sponge block 31, the conveying motor 14 is started to drive the conveying shaft 15 to rotate, the conveying shaft 15 drives the rotating plate 16 to rotate, the rotating plate 16 drives the conveying box 18 to rotate through the connecting plate 17, when the conveying box 18 with the test tube rotates to the right side, the sliding ball 36 can slide on the surface of the arc-shaped plate 41, so that the connecting rod 35 firstly ascends, then does not move and then descends;

in the ascending process of the lifting plate 37, the direction changing plate 33 moves inwards by overcoming the tension of the tension spring 38 along with the continuous ascending of the inserting block 42, the tension spring 38 further drives the clamping block 26 to move, the test tube is clamped, and the state of the test tube is adjusted to be vertical;

when the lifting plate 37 descends, the clamping block 26 can return to the initial position under the action of the elastic force of the tension spring 38, so that the clamping of the test tube is released, and the test tube is in a free state and is convenient to take out;

before detection, the electric telescopic rod 46 is started, the electric telescopic rod 46 extends to push the pulling plate 48 to move, the pulling plate 48 is made to move to the position of a test tube and is abutted against the bottom end of a test tube sealing plug, then the electromagnet 50 is started, the electromagnet 50 generates attraction force on the magnetic block 51, the lifting box 45 is made to move up and down, the pulling plate 48 is driven to move, and the pulling plate 48 moves to drive the sealing plug to be separated from the test tube;

when the sample is rotated to the rightmost direction, detection is carried out at the moment, the hydraulic cylinder 21 is started to control the hydraulic rod 58 to extend, the hydraulic rod 58 drives the liquid pump 22 to move downwards, the suction pipe 25 is inserted into the test tube, the liquid pump 22 is started, and the liquid pump 22 conveys the sample to the detector 23 through the suction pipe 25 and the hose 24 for detection;

the above-mentioned processes are repeated so as to implement quick detection.
